name: Jesus Did Not Have A Sin Nature
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that Jesus Christ, though made flesh and fully human, did not possess a sin nature. John 1:14 affirms His incarnation as the Word made flesh, full of grace and truth, while Hebrews 4:15 emphasizes that He was tempted in every way yet remained without sin. Romans 8:3 explains that God sent His Son in the likeness of sinful flesh to condemn sin, not to partake in it, and Hebrews 9:14 highlights that Christ offered Himself without spot or fault. This truth distinguishes Jesus from all humanity, who inherit sin through Adam (Romans 5:12), and underscores that God Himself cannot be tempted by evil (James 1:13).
